description:
Three tickets completing the client–server interaction model:

  E1 — use_hold/3 hook + Filament.Hold.GenServer macro
       Acquires a server-side resource hold on mount; released automatically
       via BEAM :DOWN monitoring when the LiveView disconnects or the fiber unmounts.

  E2 — defevent macro
       Generates a typed event struct with encode/1, decode/1, @type t, and
       compile-time field validation. The primitive for typed browser→server payloads.

  E3 — Event closures on fibers
       on_click / on_submit attributes in ~F templates register handler fns on the
       fiber at render time. The ~F compiler emits phx-click="filament:ref" wire
       attributes. LiveView routes the incoming event to the registered closure.

Build plan: filament/.tmp/plan.html § Track E

Prerequisites:
  Track B fully merged (flm-t8j — all closed ✓)
  Track C fully merged (flm-oue — all closed ✓)
  E2 must be merged before E3 (E3 integrates defevent for typed payloads).
title: Track E: Resource holds and typed event dispatch
